recentItems.title: Stolen 'MAFIA' Corvette from street takeover found abandoned on I-80 after chase
recentItems.description:
A blue Corvette captured doing donuts during a street takeover in downtown Stroudsburg was later found by abandoned on I-80 after a police chase, according to authorities. Police say the sports car was stolen from a Rhode Island dealership and was displaying fake New York plates reading “MAFIA.” The investigation remains ongoing.

recentItems.title: Beloved Sayville mom found dead in home, police say attack was targeted
recentItems.description:
A Sayville community is mourning the loss of 62-year-old Rachel Frislid after police say she was killed in a violent attack. Authorities say a family member found her unconscious at her Pearl Court home Thursday night, and she was declared dead at the scene. Police believe the attack was targeted and say the investigation remains active.

recentItems.title: What’s moving into this Brooklyn department store? Developers reveal major new tenants
recentItems.description:

Developers say Burlington has signed on and a mystery national grocery chain will become the first national grocer to serve southwest Brooklyn. While some welcome new retail options, local business owners are watching closely as the neighborhood continues to evolve.

recentItems.title: Inside the stunning costumes for Brooklyn’s West Indian Day Parade
recentItems.description:

Suga Candy Mas leaders Maxine and Kyle Borneo offer a behind-the-scenes look at the yearlong effort that goes into creating their "Bejeweled" theme. For participants, the celebration is about more than costumes, it's a showcase of culture, unity and Caribbean pride.

recentItems.title: What went wrong? MTA worker killed by train while on the job
recentItems.description:
A multi-agency investigation is underway after the MTA says a worker was struck and killed by a train at the 161st Street-Yankee Stadium subway station. Sources close to the investigation say 41-year-old Moet McCullum was working on the tracks as a construction flagger when she was hit by a D train. The Transit Workers Union says McCullum was a mother of three and that workers and her family are devastated by the loss.

recentItems.title: Parolee charged in deadly Bronx bodega shooting indicted on 14 counts
recentItems.description:
A Bronx man accused of a deadly shooting inside a Mott Haven bodega has been indicted on 14 counts, including first-degree murder, manslaughter, robbery, and weapons charges. Prosecutors say Jesus Acosta fatally shot 33-year-old Tayvon Shuler, injured a bodega worker, and fired at three other people before fleeing. Authorities arrested Acosta after a weeklong manhunt, and he has pleaded not guilty. The Bronx shooting came two days after police say Acosta killed a 44-year-old man in a shooting at a Brownsville restaurant.

recentItems.title: Knife-wielding man fatally shot by NYPD on Brooklyn Bridge
recentItems.description:
A man carrying a knife and claiming he had a bomb was fatally shot by police on the Brooklyn Bridge after an extended standoff. Police say officers spent about an hour trying to get the man down safely before he moved toward them with the knife. Officers immediately rendered aid, and the incident is now under investigation by the Force Investigation Division.

recentItems.description:
